"Choose a .lcsave backup or an external .sav for this same game and version. External .sav files cannot verify which ROM they belong to. It will replace the current save; a backup of the previous save will remain on your phone. The game will restart to load it."
"Save exported. Keep it to transfer your progress to another phone."

"Choose a folder to see all its .gba games. Tap Refresh after adding files. For covers, place Juego.png or Juego.jpg next to Juego.gba, or tap ⋯ on a card to choose an image. Use Download covers to find artwork on Libretro. Games without a cover display a generic cartridge; gameplay previews are not generated.

Open an uncompressed .gba file. Bruma GBA remembers your last game.

Save from the game menu. Use Pause to export a .lcsave backup and import it on another phone with the exact same ROM.

Returning home keeps the session paused. If Android closes the app, in-game saves remain, but the current moment is not saved.

Use RPG Maker · Experimental to import the folder of an RPG Maker XP game. Bruma copies it into its private storage and leaves the original unchanged. Compatibility varies by game.

No controller detected. Connect it to this phone by USB or pair it in Android Bluetooth settings.

For controllers recognized by Android.

D-pad / left stick: move
A / Cross: GBA A · B / Circle: GBA B
X / Square: GBA B · Y / Triangle: GBA A
LB / L1 and LT / L2: L
RB / R1 and RT / R2: R
Start / Options: START · Select / View / Create: SELECT
Press right stick: pause
Press left stick: 1× / 2× / 4×

Use Assign buttons if the layout differs. Assignments are saved per controller. Analog triggers keep their default actions.
Press and release a controller button to assign it.
